AUTHOR: Papadaki
TITLE: Unlocking flow-habitat relationships in mountain rivers of Epirus, Greece using object detection and hydrodynamic simulation
SPECIES: fish (river dominated by West Balkan trout Salmo farioides)
DATA: Own stereo-video recordings at 16 pool-riffle transition locations, Sept-Oct 2022; 144 annotated images
V_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'Data collection occurred during daytime with clear visibility, with the cameras positioned perpendicular to the flow.'
D_EV: Sec. 3.3: 'We used K = 5 different partitions of the dataset... divided into three subsets of training, validation and test data with the proportions of 60 %, 20 % and 20 %'
R_EV: Sec. 3.3/4.1: single dataset of 144 images from one river campaign; Table 1 reports test results on its own partitions only
C_EV: no statement found (only IoU threshold 0.5; Fig. 4 shows confidence scores but no score threshold value; unannotated detections discussed qualitatively, not counted)
E_EV: Sec. 3.3: 'we adopted the mean Average Precision (mAP)... as the primary metric... We also report Precision, Recall and... mAP50'
ARCH: YOLOv8 and Faster R-CNN (with augmentation ablations)
METR: Precision, Recall, F1, mAP50, mAP50-95 (mean and 95% CI over 5 partitions)
NOTE: V_ALL=N applied via policy P1: Methods state recording only 'during daytime with clear visibility' with no visibility measurement; but Results/Abstract also call the images 'turbid' (qualitative, contradictory) - verifier check (alternative V_ALL=P). V2/V4: in-situ depth measured at locations; fish-camera distance zones 0.2-4.5 m; V3 daytime. Habitat suitability curves/WUA are built from manually measured FEMPs via videogrammetry software (Neuswanger et al.), NOT from the AI detections, so E1=없음 (AI output not linked to the ecological variable). CI in Table 1 is across data partitions, not model uncertainty (C3=없음). Part of data/test examples on GitHub; code on request.
